FC4028 Neutron Ambient Dose Equivalent (Rate) Meter

Neutron Probe Detector: 3He Proportional Counter + Polyethylene Moderator (Spherical)
Neutron Real-time Dose Equivalent Rate: 0.01μSv/h - 99.99mSv/h
Radiation protection for nuclear facilities, nuclear supervision and source-related enterprises; oil exploration neutron detection; prospecting operations; environmental monitoring departments, CDC emergency response; security for major events and overseas embassies/consulates; nuclear and radiation counter-terrorism for customs, ports, and border defense to prevent illegal radioactive material transport; third-party testing institutions.
Get quotationWhatsApp
This neutron dose rate meter is an intelligent radiation measurement instrument that uses a smart probe connected to a multi-functional radiation measurement host. This instrument enriches the smart probe series and expands the application of multi-functional radiation measurement instruments. The instrument achieves product serialization based on a unified inspection system software platform and one multi-functional radiation measurement instrument. Customers can meet various usage requirements by selecting different probes. The probe uses a 3He proportional counter tube plus polyethylene moderator for measuring neutron dose rate. This product is widely used for neutron dose rate detection in nuclear power plants, nuclear power installations, research nuclear reactors, accelerators, and neutron source operations, and can also be used by environmental protection bureaus at all levels, CDC, oil logging, etc. Compliant with standard: GB/T 14318-2019/IEC 61005:2014.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Features

  • The instrument uses high-sensitivity imported detectors with fast response speed. The instrument is convenient to use.
  • High sensitivity, good anti-γ performance, and good energy response characteristics.
  • Can be used as both a portable instrument and a fixed neutron dose monitor, can be connected to various professional radiation measurement probes, and can be linked to a host computer with analysis software for professional analysis.
  • Independent gamma and neutron measurement channels with alarm prompts.
  • Alarm thresholds are continuously adjustable, with audible and visual alarm prompts.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
